name: Cache Rebuild Performance Monitor
description: Monitors filetree cache rebuild performance and detects slow rebuilds

scenarios.name: Slow Cache Rebuild
scenarios.description: Cache rebuild took longer than expected

template.introduction:
🐌 **Slow Cache Rebuild Detected**

The file tree cache rebuild took **{{cache.rebuild.duration_ms}}ms**, which exceeds the 500ms performance target.

This trace shows the complete flow from file change detection through cache rebuild.

events.filetree.cache.invalidated: Cache marked stale (was version {{cache.version.before}}), rebuild scheduled: {{cache.rebuild.scheduled}}

template.summary:
**Performance Analysis:**
- Duration: **{{cache.rebuild.duration_ms}}ms** (target: <500ms)
- Files processed: {{filetree.files_count}}
- New cache version: {{cache.version.after}}

**Possible causes:**
- Large repository ({{filetree.files_count}} files)
- Slow disk I/O
- CPU contention

**Recommendations:**
- Consider incremental cache updates
- Profile the file tree builder
- Check disk performance

template.introduction:
📦 **Large Batch Operation**

Detected a batch of **{{debounce.changes_count}} file changes** in repository `{{repository.path}}`.

This is likely a bulk operation like `git checkout`, `git pull`, or mass file operations. The debounce mechanism successfully batched all changes into a single rebuild.
template.summary:
**Batch Operation Summary:**
- Changes batched: **{{debounce.changes_count}}** files
- Debounce window: {{debounce.delay_ms}}ms
- Repository: `{{repository.path}}`

**Benefit:** Instead of {{debounce.changes_count}} separate rebuilds, the system performed just **1 rebuild**, saving significant CPU and I/O.

scenarios.name: Duplicate Event Detected
scenarios.description: Deduplication guard caught a duplicate event

template.introduction:
🔄 **Duplicate Event Dropped**

The deduplication guard in the preload bridge detected and dropped a duplicate event.

Event key: `{{dedup.event_key}}`
Time since last seen: {{dedup.time_since_last_ms}}ms (window: {{dedup.window_ms}}ms)

events.filetree.cache.synced: CACHE_SYNC IPC event emitted with cache version {{cache.version}}

template.summary:
**Deduplication Details:**
- Event type: {{event.type}}
- Dedup key: `{{dedup.event_key}}`
- Time since last: {{dedup.time_since_last_ms}}ms
- Dedup window: {{dedup.window_ms}}ms

**Root Cause:** electron-log's IPC transport mechanism causes duplicate event delivery. The deduplication guard successfully prevented duplicate processing.
